## S. Circular economy in practice — 8 October 2026 cross-sector gap audit

AMR is a brand of a small private NSW company, Scrap Metal Services Pty Ltd, incorporated in 2020 and originally based in the Maitland area. In March–April 2025 it took on the Australian Metal Refiners (Central Coast) and Wilson Metal names. By mid-2025 it held the former InfraBuild-owned Matthews Metal Management regional yards, including Dubbo. Its shareholders and directors were not found publicly.
